standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the diagonal of a map of spectral spaces through the topology of the fibre product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 432-440)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the diagonal being a closed immersion into a condition on the diagonal as a subspace.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the diagonal of a separated map is a closed immersion, and its image is exactly the diagonal subset of the fibre product (proof lines 431-437)
(2) implies (3): if the diagonal subset is closed then the diagonal is a closed immersion because it is a homeomorphism onto its image (proof lines 438-444)
(3) implies (4): closedness of the diagonal subset is a special case of the stated condition with the two maps equal (proof lines 445-455)
(4) implies (1): the condition characterizes separatedness of a map of spectral spaces (proof lines 456-461)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：Δ 是闭浸入 ⇒ 其像（即对角子集）闭。
(2)⇒(3)：对角子集闭 ⇒ Δ 到其像是同胚 ⇒ 闭浸入。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives four equivalent formulations of separatedness for a map of spectral spaces, the last of them a closure condition on the pairwise intersections of the images of the two projections (author lemma at source lines 419-429, label lemma-separated). The proof (source lines 431-462) runs the cycle of implications, using that the diagonal is a homeomorphism onto the diagonal subset (proof lines 431-461). The identification of the diagonal with the diagonal subset is the content. H3.
